description: Escape of water from Flat 4 through the kitchen ceiling of Flat 3 (reported by the Flat 3 occupier by phone 19:35 Sat 10/10). Tenant away 9-12 Oct.

history.note: Swift assigned as emergency, ETA 20:30. Out-of-hours key holder to meet Swift at the property for emergency entry. Caller told to keep away from the wet light fitting and switch that circuit off at the consumer unit if dry and safe.
Tenant called (voicemail); SMS and email sent explaining emergency entry.
Landlord Ben Hartley emailed: leak, emergency entry, Swift attending, possible insurance claim.
Arrived at 12 Mare Street. Waiting for plumber before entering.
Called Swift for an update: voicemail, message left.
Called Swift again: voicemail. No reply to text.
